game.romname: Elder Scrolls IV, The - Shivering Isles (Germany)
game.name: Elder Scrolls IV : Oblivion : The Shivering Is, The (Germany)
game.desc: The Shivering Isles brings some new features to The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion role-playing game on Xbox 360. Discover eleven new quests, new weapons and armour, creatures and various works. About thirty hours of gameplay have been added for a total immersion where you will have to fight against new enemies populating the mysterious islands.
